name: campusassist
description: CampusAssist - Smart Academic Management & Collaboration Platform

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:
npm run install:all && echo '
Setup database with: psql -U postgres -d campusassist -f backend/database/schema.sql
Then update backend/.env with your PostgreSQL password
Then run: npm run backend (terminal 1) && npm run frontend (terminal 2)'
